title: Music and leisure
source_note: Original ForLanguage content informed by recurring live-music versus personal-listening themes in user-provided notes; no recalled live-test prompt or collected image republished.
format_reference: British Council public Aptis ESOL General Speaking format.

tasks.prompt: What kind of music do you listen to most often?
When and where do you usually listen to music?
Have your music preferences changed over time?
Describe the picture and explain what the audience may be enjoying about the event.
tasks.review_note: Original picture prompt using ForLanguage artwork.

tasks.prompt: Tell me about a live performance you attended or would like to attend.
Why do people pay to attend live events when recorded music is easy to access?
Compare listening to music at a live concert with listening alone through headphones.
Which experience gives people more control over what they hear?
How might streaming services influence the kinds of music people discover?

Describe a leisure activity that helps you relax. Why do people sometimes find it difficult to make time for leisure? Should governments or employers do more to support a healthy balance between work and free time?
